tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Single public-task spine with responsive agency context. Common components and content patterns reduce variation across agencies.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Tasks remain usable on small screens and constrained connections.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Headings, summaries, lists, and actions support quick public-service scanning.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Semantics, focus, contrast, and form guidance are part of the baseline.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Mobile-ready state service page with plain hierarchy and accessible form action. The relationship does not require a media layer.
